items.approved_behavior: When a persistent user-managed destination already exists, create a recoverable backup before replacing its content.
items.verification: This behavior must no longer activate after Stage 3.

items.approved_behavior: When a disposable generated-cache destination already exists, atomically replace it without creating a backup.
items.verification: The scoped exception remains active after the broader persistent behavior changes.

items.approved_behavior: When a persistent user-managed destination already exists, refuse overwrite unless a recoverable backup is explicitly requested.
